name: AnNIXion Engagement Report

fields.label: Report Title
fields.default: Red Team Engagement Report

fields.label: Client
fields.default: TODO Client Ltd

fields.label: Engagement Type
fields.default: Red Team

fields.label: Classification
fields.default: TLP:AMBER+STRICT

fields.label: Executive Summary
fields.default: TODO: what was attempted, what succeeded, and what it means in business terms. No tool names, no jargon — this page is read by people who will not read page 20.

fields.label: Key Judgements
fields.default:
* TODO The objective was achieved / not achieved, and by what route.
* TODO The control that failed first.
* TODO The control that worked, and should be kept.

fields.label: Business Impact
fields.default: TODO: the consequence in the client's own terms — data, money, continuity, obligation.

fields.label: Overall Posture
fields.default: Developing

fields.label: Posture Rationale
fields.default: TODO: why that rating and not the one above it.

fields.label: Objectives
fields.default: TODO: the flags the client set. Crown-jewel access, a specific data set, domain compromise, physical entry to a named site.

fields.label: In Scope
fields.default: TODO: ranges, domains, sites, personnel groups, applications.

fields.label: Out of Scope
fields.default: TODO: what was explicitly excluded, and why it matters to the result.

fields.label: Rules of Engagement
fields.default: TODO: permitted techniques, prohibited techniques, working hours, data-handling rules, stop conditions and who may invoke them.

fields.label: Deconfliction & Escalation
fields.default: TODO: named contacts, out-of-hours route, and the agreed proof-of-engagement process.

fields.label: Limitations
fields.default: TODO: what constrained the test — time, scope, availability, a control that could not be tested safely. State these plainly; they bound the conclusions.

fields.label: Approach
fields.default: TODO: the phases run and why, mapped to a recognised framework (PTES, OSSTMM, MITRE ATT&CK, TIBER-EU).

fields.label: Threat Model Emulated
fields.default: TODO: the actor whose behaviour was emulated and the reason that profile was chosen.

fields.label: Tooling
fields.default: TODO: significant tooling, and anything custom-built for this engagement.

fields.label: Summary
fields.default: TODO: what an attacker can learn before touching anything, and what it enabled here.

fields.label: External Attack Surface
fields.default: TODO: domains, hosts and services discovered, including what was not in the client's inventory.

fields.label: Credential & Data Exposure
fields.default: TODO: breach corpora, infostealer logs, repositories, document metadata.

fields.label: Personnel Exposure
fields.default: TODO: the staff detail that made the pretexts credible, and where it came from.

fields.label: Summary
fields.default: TODO: campaigns run, what they asked for, and what they got.

fields.label: Pretexts Used
fields.default: TODO: each pretext, the channel, and why it was chosen for that audience.

fields.label: Analysis
fields.default: TODO: what the numbers mean. A click rate is not a finding; the reporting rate, the time to report and what happened after the report are.

fields.label: Summary
fields.default: TODO: sites attempted, entry achieved, time inside, objectives met.

fields.label: Entry Narrative
fields.default: TODO: the route in, step by step, with timestamps and photographs. This is the section the client's facilities team will act on.

fields.label: Artefacts Placed & Recovered
fields.default: TODO: devices placed, where, what access they gave, and confirmation of recovery.

fields.label: Detection & Response
fields.default: TODO: who noticed, when, and what happened next — including nobody noticing.

fields.label: Summary
fields.default: TODO: the chain from first access to objective, in one paragraph.

fields.label: Initial Access
fields.default: TODO: how the first foothold was obtained, with evidence.

fields.label: Privilege Escalation
fields.default: TODO: local and domain escalation, with the flaw that allowed it.

fields.label: Lateral Movement
fields.default: TODO: the hosts traversed and the credentials that made it possible.

fields.label: Persistence
fields.default: TODO: mechanisms established, where, and confirmation of removal.

fields.label: Objectives Achieved
fields.default: TODO: each objective, achieved or not, with the evidence that proves it.

fields.label: Data Accessed
fields.default: TODO: what could be reached, what was actually accessed, and how it was handled.

fields.label: Summary
fields.default: TODO: what the defenders saw, when, and what they did — measured against the activity log.

fields.label: Gaps
fields.default: TODO: the techniques that produced no alert, and whether the telemetry existed at all.

fields.label: What Worked
fields.default: TODO: name it. A report that only lists failures gets read as unfair.

fields.label: Summary
fields.default: TODO: the shape of the work, not a restatement of every finding.

fields.label: Immediate (0–7 days)
fields.default: * TODO Contain what is currently exploitable.

fields.label: Short Term (1–4 weeks)
fields.default: * TODO Remove the route that was used.

fields.label: Medium Term (1–3 months)
fields.default: * TODO Remove the class of route.

fields.label: Strategic
fields.default: * TODO The structural change that makes this engagement hard to repeat.

fields.label: Severity Definitions
fields.default: TODO: how severity was assigned.

fields.label: MITRE ATT&CK Mapping
fields.default: TODO: techniques used, by phase.

fields.label: Indicators & Cleanup
fields.default: TODO: accounts, files, implants, infrastructure and C2 addresses used, with confirmation of removal. The client needs this to verify the estate is clean.

fields.label: Evidence Index
fields.default: TODO: evidence identifiers and where they are held.

finding_fields.label: Summary
finding_fields.default: TODO: what the issue is, in two sentences.

finding_fields.label: Description
finding_fields.default: TODO: the issue, why it exists, and what it allows.

finding_fields.label: Evidence
finding_fields.default: TODO: the proof — commands, output, screenshots, timestamps.

finding_fields.label: Impact
finding_fields.default: TODO: the consequence for this client, not in the abstract.

finding_fields.label: Recommendation
finding_fields.default: TODO: what to change, specifically enough to action.

findings.title: Shared local administrator password across the estate
findings.summary: One local administrator password was shared by every workstation.
findings.description: Recovered from the first host and reused across the estate.
findings.impact: One workstation compromise became estate-wide administrative access.
findings.recommendation: Deploy LAPS so each host holds a unique rotated password.
